artifact: B1 GEO connector ATAC recognition real-data validation
summary: Validation of the GEO connector's ATAC support (B1) against real NCBI GEO accessions. Confirms _infer_data_type types real ATAC studies as scATAC/bulk_ATAC (not collapsed to RNA), _download_supplementary/_classify_suppl_file buckets real ATAC artifacts (fragments/peaks), and _geo_bucket_map routes them to the ChromatinAgent. One full end-to-end fetch() downloaded real bytes; the rest validate typing+bucketing against real supplementary listings (no multi-GB downloads).

validates: real SOFT metadata -> _infer_data_type yields scATAC/bulk_ATAC for real ATAC studies
_geo_bucket_map routes ATAC buckets to the ChromatinAgent (not the RNA lane)
a full GEOConnector.fetch() downloads + buckets real bytes end-to-end
does_not_validate: downstream ChromatinAgent processing of the downloaded files (separate lanes)
fragments/BAM downloads were not pulled for the GB-scale accessions (listing-only)

listing_classification.note: fragments file (1.5 GB) NOT downloaded; classification is from the real listing

listing_classification.finding: Pre-dates the GEO 'ATAC-seq' library_strategy term and uses a descriptive title ('Transposition of native chromatin ... open chromatin') with no literal 'atac'. Validation surfaced this gap; _infer_data_type ATAC keywords were broadened with ATAC-specific terms (transposase, 'transposition of native chromatin', bare 'atacseq'). 'open chromatin' deliberately NOT added (DNase-seq also uses it).

known_limitations.generic_bed_not_bucketed: Peak files named as generic *.bed/*.bed.gz without 'peak'/narrowPeak/broadPeak in the name (e.g. GSE47753's ZINBA *_pp08.bed.gz) are left UNCLASSIFIED to avoid mis-bucketing non-peak BED (annotations, blacklists, enhancers). Modern ATAC peaks (narrowPeak/broadPeak or *peak*.bed) are bucketed.
known_limitations.negative_control: DNase-seq 'open chromatin' studies correctly remain 'unknown' (not mis-typed as ATAC).

provenance.note: Live network validation against NCBI GEO. Accession contents may change upstream; data_type/bucket logic is pinned by tests/test_geo_atac_inference.py.
